title: Velista: a basket row records buys, and a detailed view of its lists
lede: Velista plans 0201 (the row sheet records what was bought for each list) and 0200 (a detailed view, rows/:rowKey/lists, holds each list's ask and the change of product), with backend 0273 behind the first. They ship together, so every frame draws the end state of both. Each board shows Day in English on the left and Night in Spanish on the right; the Spanish words are the proposed es keys. The row sheet gains a heading and one text button where "Change for all lists" was; the detailed view is a sheet like the shop picker, with the chevron beside its title. No container, no tint, no banner. Two boards are choices, lettered: the default of each is A. The board marked Today is drawn from the source on dev, because the staging test account no longer signs in. Generated from the committed *.dc.html artboards and the notes in canvas.json.

annotations.text:
TODAY.
Each list has the swap icon in a bordered square, which changes the product of that list's line, and a stepper that changes what the list asks for.
Drawn from row-entries and the stepper on dev, not photographed: the staging account no longer signs in.

0201 TARGET STATES 2, 5, 6, 8; 0200 TARGET STATE 2.
One job: the heading says What you bought. Each stepper counts what this basket bought for that list in this trip, and each name carries the list's ask. Compra semanal asks 3, has 1. Básicos asks 2, has 2: green. Cocina asks 1, has 2: amber.
No swap icon. Lists and amounts, at the right of the heading, opens the detailed view.

0200 SPECS 1; 0201 SPECS 6.
A guest whose lists allow no change of ask or product sees no Lists and amounts, so no page of numbers it can only read. A guest may still record buys, so the steppers stay. Bought for another list is never drawn for a guest.

0200 TARGET STATES 1, 3. CHOOSE A OR B.
A sheet over the basket, reached from the row sheet; the chevron goes back to it. One larger row per list: name, zone · line, then Bought 2 of 3 in plain text that cannot be pressed. The ask is the only control. Change product opens the change sheet of that list.
A: the ask stepper sits where the buy stepper sat in the row sheet, so the eye finds the control at the same place. Básicos may change its ask only; Another list may change neither, so its ask is a plain number in the stepper's column.
Which letter?

0200 TARGET STATE 3, CHOICE B.
The ask gets its own line with a small Asks for at its start and the wider sheet stepper. It names the number outright, at the cost of a taller row: three lists fill most of the screen.
Bought 2 of 3 stays in the name block in both layouts, so the read only number and the editable one never share a line.

0200 TARGET STATE 4.
Two lists may change their product, so Change for all lists closes the heading's row, as it does in the row sheet today. Drawn with layout A.

0201 TARGET STATE 5.
The name gives way first: Compra semanal de la… · 1,5 kg. The ask is never cut. The line under it is cut on its own.
A product by weight shows the ask in its exact form with the unit, and the stepper the figure over kg, as the sheet stepper already does.

0200 FRAME 4.
In the detailed view the name and its zone · line are cut; Bought 0,5 of 1,5 kg and the stepper are not. Drawn with layout A, where the name has the least room.

0201 TARGET STATE 7.
Add it to another list becomes Bought for another list. Its steppers start at 0 and a press up records a buy for that list. Despensa is stepped to 1.
When the answer comes back, Despensa becomes a list of the row, Despensa · 0, with its 1 in amber, and leaves this section.

CHOICE, THE COLOURS.
A: the number only, as the plans say. B: the number and the ask after the name, in the same colour, so the eye joins them. C, the louder one: the number and the capsule's edge, the same 2 px edge an add already draws.
Green is the success colour and amber the quiet action colour, in both themes. Which letter?
